fed.cme_source: Altınla FedWatch PRIMARY (bins_sane) / ZQV26 96.12 · Oct28 hold(3.75–4.00)=0.793 hike(4.00–4.25)=0.207 · asof Updated: October 4, 2026 at 11:50 PM UTC · Yahoo ZQV26.CBT 96.12 confirms · Investing secondary hike=0.23 hold=0.77 (Oct 03, 2026 12:35AM EDT)
fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.165 vs Altınla CME-method hike-bin 0.207 (gap 4.2pp) — mismatch_flag false (<~8–10pp). Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0278 after 5% fees — no edge. Investing secondary hike=0.23. Contracts are not identical (CME 4.00–4.25 bin ≈ PM exclusive +25bp only from current 3.75–4.00).
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.165 对 Altınla CME 方法加息档 0.207（缺口 4.2 个百分点）——错配标记 false（<约 8–10pp）。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0278，无边。Investing 次源加息档 0.23。合约不完全相同（CME 4.00–4.25 档仅在当前 3.75–4.00 时约等于 PM 独家 +25bp）。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

receipt.title: Brazil Presidential Election First Round Winner
receipt.missing: Flavio Bolsonaro leg has no live ask (empty sell book) — exclusive-Yes partition incomplete
receipt.reason_en: Scanner summed 12 asks of 13 legs (all at 0.1–0.2¢). The Flavio Bolsonaro leg had no ask at all, so the set is not exhaustive. A $0.0135 ‘cost’ for a $1 payout is the missing-leg artifact, not a misprice. Same pattern rejected on the 2nd-place event.
receipt.reason_zh: 扫描只加总了 13 条腿中的 12 条卖一（都在 0.1–0.2¢）。Flavio Bolsonaro 那条腿完全没有卖一，互斥组不穷尽。$1 赔付只要 $0.0135 是缺腿假象，不是错价。第二名事件同样被否。
receipt.recheck_en: Re-check only if every leg (including the favourite) shows a live ask with size and sum(ask)+fees < 1 against the full event market count.
receipt.recheck_zh: 只有每条腿（含热门）都有带深度的卖一、且相对事件全部市场 sum(ask)+费 < 1 时才重检。

scan.near_miss_filter_en: Raw near-misses are Yes+No (or exclusive-set) net within a few cents of $1. Most are longshot dust. Watch list keeps incomplete partitions and the live Fed book.
scan.near_miss_filter_zh: 原始近失是 Yes+No（或互斥组）扣费后净成本离 $1 只差几分。多数是长尾尘埃。观察名单只留分区不完整、以及在轨的美联储盘。
scan.count_rule_en: 762 = 752 Yes/No books + 10 NegRisk events. Full set in universe.json.
scan.count_rule_zh: 762 = 752 个 Yes/No 盘 + 10 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Book / fill depth is unverified. Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。盘口/成交深度未核验。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). 14–16 Sep snapshots are public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Sep NFP public pre-print freeze is ship 2026-10-01-1051 (commit c416920); its print result is appended as 2026-10-05-nfp-print without rewriting freeze rows. Results are append-only.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的事前公开冻结。9 月非农公开事前冻盘是船 2026-10-01-1051（commit c416920）；其公布结果以 2026-10-05-nfp-print 追加，冻盘行不改写。结果只追加。

notify.en: No push alerts. Poll desk.json. If verdict or scan.after_audit changes, the conclusion changed. GitHub commits are the publish log.
notify.zh: 没有推送。轮询 desk.json。verdict 或 scan.after_audit 变了就是结论变了。GitHub commit 是发布记录。
